claim: Avoid lazy loading by default (hidden queries, N+1).
excerpt: - **Related data** — explicit query shape: projection for selected related data, `Include`/`ThenInclude` when the graph itself is needed; avoid lazy loading by default (hidden queries, N+1); consider split queries for large collection includes and verify the SQL.

claim: Decorators via Scrutor only when it is already present; Scrutor is not added for one decoration.
excerpt: - **Decorator** — wraps an abstraction with cross-cutting behavior (`LoggingOrderService(IOrderService inner, ILogger<LoggingOrderService> logger)`). With Scrutor already present: `services.Decorate<IOrderService, LoggingOrderService>();` — do not add Scrutor for one decoration.

claim: Swashbuckle Swagger UI is the Development documentation and manual-testing surface at /swagger; exposure outside Development only when deployment requirements justify it.
excerpt: - Decided: Swashbuckle Swagger UI is the interactive API documentation and manual-testing surface for Development (`/swagger`); expose it outside Development only when deployment requirements explicitly justify it.

claim: Deny-listed packages must not be added; approval-listed packages require approval and removal unless the user approved them.
excerpt:
for (const r of packageMatches(id, rules.nugetDenied)) findings.push(`${rel}: '${id}' must not be added — ${r.reason} (owner: ${r.owner}).`);
    for (const r of packageMatches(id, rules.nugetApproval)) findings.push(`${rel}: '${id}' requires approval — ${r.reason} (owner: ${r.owner}). Remove it unless the user approved it.`);

claim: Prefer destructuring to selected properties and keep destructuring limits configured.
excerpt: - `{@Value}` destructures an object, `{$Value}` forces `ToString()`; prefer destructuring to selected properties (`.Destructure.ByTransforming<HttpRequest>(r => new { r.Method, r.Path })`) and keep destructuring limits configured.

claim: When representative data exists (checked through anchor entities) leave it unchanged; the seeder never synchronizes, repairs, upgrades, overwrites or recreates; developers recreate explicitly.
excerpt: - When representative data already exists (checked through one or more anchor entities), leave it unchanged: the seeder is never an automatic synchronization, repair, upgrade, overwrite, or recreation mechanism. Developers recreate a local database explicitly when they need a fresh dataset.

claim: Application must not depend on IGenericRepository<T> or another generic CRUD contract; a generic repository base may exist only inside Infrastructure to remove real duplication.
excerpt: - Application must not depend on `IGenericRepository<T>` or another generic CRUD contract; a generic repository base class may exist only inside Infrastructure, only to remove real duplication, and never as a replacement for the ORM's query capabilities.

claim: Do not issue custom JWTs when an existing provider already issues tokens.
excerpt: - an external OpenID Connect/OAuth provider when identity is delegated; do not issue custom JWTs when an existing provider already issues tokens.
